verdicts.reason: Both are broken the same way. The turbine icon (the hero image) and the coloured triangles are crushed into a tiny strip on the left, so the hero is now a thumbnail. The headline is pushed hard to the right, and the lower half is dead space with only stray diagonal lines. A also leaves the headline nearly touching the right edge and its top line's dot almost touching 'MARCH 18'. B's headline is a little bigger and has more space around it, but it's still off-axis and the brand imagery is just as unrecognisable.
